# Tessellate Logistics - API gateway

The gateway fronts the partner portals: shipment quote and tracking reads, label printing
and the rate-sheet sync that feeds the quoting engine. Everything is served under /api/v3.

logs/tessellate-access.log is the access trail for 2026-03-11, one line per request the
gateway answered:

    <UTC timestamp> <method> <path> <status> dur_ms=<upstream milliseconds> up=<upstream pool>

dur_ms is the time the named upstream pool took to answer, measured by the gateway. An
answer in the 5xx range means the request failed; the gateway performs no retries of its
own, so one line is one upstream attempt. Cutover and configuration events are interleaved
as plain INFO lines.
